newsitem.title: USA: Gulfstream Aerospace delivers first V jet. [CORRECTED 16:16 GMT 1/1]
newsitem.headline: Gulfstream Aerospace delivers first V jet. [CORRECTED 16:16 GMT 1/1]

text.p: Gulfstream Aerospace Corp said it delivered its first ultra-long range business jet, the Gulfstream V, to an international customer.

The company did not name the customer nor disclose what the customer paid for the jet, which has a non-stop range of 6,500 miles and is available to the market 18 months sooner than competing jets, according to Gulfstream.
The company said it expects to fully outfit the jet to the customer's specifications by the second quarter of 1997.
The company said it expects to deliver the Gulfstream V ordered today in the fourth quarter of 1999. (Corrects delivery timetable).
